description: A small ecosystem to watch. Conway's Classic and three new organisms (Ember Raiders, Moss Weavers, Amber Tide) fight over one dish, each with its own dominance and invasion habits. Press play on Four Corners to see a chain of conquest unfold, or on Tug of War for a compact skirmish, then open an organism to read the rules behind what you saw.

payload.summary: Born on an empty cell with exactly 3 neighbors

organisms.name: Ember Raiders
organisms.description: A hard-hitting colony that grows like Conway's Life and raids any Amber Tide cell it touches on two sides. Dominance 70 beats Amber Tide and Conway's Classic in a fight, but Moss Weavers outrank it.

payload.summary: Raids an Amber Tide cell touching 2 or more Raiders
Claims an empty cell with exactly 3 Raider neighbors
Holds on with 2 or 3 Raider neighbors

organisms.name: Moss Weavers
organisms.description: The top-ranked organism: nobody outranks dominance 75. It sprouts in lively bursts (3 or 6 neighbors) and overgrows any Ember Raiders cell it touches on two sides, so watch the green front push into red.

payload.summary: Overgrows an Ember Raiders cell touching 2 or more Weavers
Sprouts on an empty cell with exactly 3 Weaver neighbors
Sprouts on an empty cell with exactly 6 Weaver neighbors
Holds on with 2 or 3 Weaver neighbors

organisms.name: Amber Tide
organisms.description: A tide that never stops renewing: cells die of old age after 30 cycles, and the shade shows how old each one is. It floods any Conway's Classic cell it touches on two sides. Dominance 60.

payload.summary: Dies of old age after 30 cycles
Floods a Conway's Classic cell touching 2 or more Tide cells
Spreads onto an empty cell with exactly 3 Tide neighbors
Holds on with 2 or 3 Tide neighbors

battles.name: Four Corners
battles.description: Four colonies start in the corners of a 100x60 dish and collide in the middle within seconds. Watch a chain of conquest: Moss Weavers overgrow Ember Raiders, Ember Raiders raid Amber Tide, and Amber Tide floods Conway's Classic.

battles.name: Tug of War
battles.description: Moss Weavers, Amber Tide and Conway's Classic side by side on a compact 50x30 dish. Watch Amber Tide flood into Conway's cells while the green colony holds the other flank; the small dish settles fast, so the first seconds are the show.
